answer: Votes moor to living wood. Each identity grows one tree up the orchard trellis; only ringed trees berth votes at the jetty. Each epoch the key burns 12 POA and signs the fresh nonce in 60 seconds to earn one ring — one hand, one key. Lottery keepers replay one tree in six per epoch against the log. A missed, stale, or shared sign fells the tree: rings ash, burned POA forfeit, weight zero, key benched two epochs. N fakes × 12 POA = 12N POA burned per epoch; a felled fake forfeits every ring. Limit: honest keys burn the same 12.
